context: M17 o8. The empty shop, W 37th. Dust, two old chairs, light through the paper.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Two chairs. Tina on one. Me on the other. Women on Eighth getting their hair done.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: My first shop on Twenty-Ninth was smaller. I slept under the table.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: You slept under a table and now you own the street.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: I own paper. Paper owns me. Get your shop, Miss Moore. Own something real.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Rule eleven: don't like the landlord. Too late.
